name: Benchmark
concept: The plain v18 fighter: one 26-card deck (at most 3 of any card) with Safe pokes and punishable big strikes, the shared defence core (Recall, Read: every one a Guard with a Counter follow-up and a rider), two specials on the table (Rising Strike, Breaker) and a single-use Super. Two combo lines: Pressures (Jab, Lunge into Slash, Sweep) and one Convert line, Big Swing into Wind-Up.

cards.name: Recall
cards.flavour: Cover up, then bring back what you need.

cards.name: Rising Strike
cards.flavour: Faster than anything they can throw out.

cards.name: Breaker
cards.flavour: A quick heavy that cracks any guard.

super.name: Overdrive
super.flavour: Once a game: a big cash and a knockdown.

notes: v20, 9 Nov (evening, Mark): the round's heat stops at the cap (no damage at max), so every HP is lower again to keep games the same length: HP 23 (first pass 26). v20 first balance pass (9 Nov): HP 26 (v19 32), heat cap 9 (v19 9). Under heat a low cap is offence (you reach max sooner, then every Pressure and the round's heat land as damage, and the Super is cheaper), so the v19 caps, set as defence, flipped the balance (Vex and Bastion about 67%, Atlas 31%); every HP is lower to bring time-outs down. v20 (9 November 2026, Mark): heat. Tokens are your fighter powering up: your heat (the grey your Pressures build) is yours, stops at your own cap of 9, and past it lands as straight damage; a Break that beats a Guard spends it all; a Guard that beats your Pressure douses it. No meter: specials cost 3 heat and the Super your whole cap, bought at the end of a round. The core is Recall x3 and Read x3 (Charge gone); one more card of the fighter's own to stay at 26: Wind-Up x3 (the Convert line had three Starters to two Enders). Otherwise as v19. 9 Nov: grey cap 9 printed on the fighter (it used the rule's 9), so every fighter shows its cap. v19 (8 November 2026, night): two combo lines (Mark): a combo continues only with cards of its Starter's type; grabs stay out of combos except the Warden's. Convert line: Big Swing (Starter) into Wind-Up (Ender); Throw is a grab, so not in it. v19 (8 November 2026, evening): the overflow grey cap (the pile stops at the cap, grey beyond it is lost as HP) and a Convert cashes only as the clash card, so no Convert is a Linker or Ender (Mark). Every HP 2 lower to bring time-outs back into the band. Big Swing, Wind-Up, Breaker and Overdrive lose Ender; Sweep is the only Ender. HP 32. v19 test (8 November 2026): Counter icons only on Pressures (Mark), played with the grey cap (9). Moved from the v18 file: every Convert loses Counter; Lunge, Sweep gain it. Rules v18, 7 November 2026: 26 cards. Safe Jab (x2, Build 1, chip 1) and Shot (x2, speed 12, Build 3, chip 2, no icons); new Lunge x3 (the unsafe Jab); Slash x2; Sweep x2; Throw x3 (chip 1, On hit: Knockdown); Big Swing x3; Wind-Up x2 (the slow heavy: speed 1, chip 4, Ender). The 3 November deck is variants/benchmark-3nov.json.
